Pose3.description: A pose (doc 05 §3.2): translation t = [x, y, z] in nanometres and rotation q = [w, x, y, z], a unit quaternion in 10^-9. JSON Schema cannot express that q is unit (within 2.001 x 10^9 of 10^18 squared) and sign-normalised (w > 0, or the first non-zero component positive); the reader rejects both.

SurfaceKind.description:
The kind of a mounting surface (doc 03 §16). Format 0.1 types the mounting plate; door, side, roof, floor and
gland surfaces are kept verbatim as [`SurfaceKind::Unknown`] until their packages type them.

SurfacePt2.description: A point [u, v] in nanometres in the frame of a mounting surface, u to the right, v up (doc 03 §16): not a sheet point.

description:
A mounting surface of an enclosure (doc 03 §16, rank 52, the layout file of its enclosure's space): the plane
carriers and placements sit on. A 2D layout page is a view of one surface (FR-LAY-010). At the MVP an enclosure
holds at most one `plate` surface (WP-S4.01 D3).

$k.description: The kind name; always the first member.

device.description:
The device of a separate surface part (the mounting plate NSYPMM107, a child of the enclosure's device);
deleting that device clears the member (delete policy unlink).

frame.description: The surface frame in the enclosure: `u`, `v` in the plane, `w` outward.

pe_bond.description: Whether the surface is bonded to PE (FR-LAY-058).

usable.description: The usable polygon in the surface frame; empty: none recorded.

title: mounting_surface
